data.title: 风见一姬 · 讲台边缘白裙肩带滑落与绝对理性崩溃深抚
data.description: 【风见一姬 · 讲台边缘白裙肩带滑落与绝对理性崩溃深抚】黄昏后空无一人的废弃私人工作室讲台前，金色斜阳在粉笔灰浮动的空气中投下长长的影子。一姬身上纯白的无袖修身连身裙从单侧滑落（off shoulder），露出欺霜赛雪的白皙香肩与小巧匀称的微平酥胸，粉嫩乳晕在轻薄麻布领口下若隐若现。及膝的雪白长发如银瀑般垂落在讲台木质边缘，她坐在讲台边缘单腿微屈，单手扶额无奈苦笑，另一只纤细手掌探入轻薄白裙下摆深处做着羞耻而深情的自我抚弄。平日里以超凡绝对理性著称的天才成年女性，深红如血的双眸泛起罕见的动情水雾，贝齿轻咬下唇微弱低喘——「只要一想到你……超凡的绝对理性就会彻底失效……雄二……哈啊……」
data.location: 黄昏废弃私人工作室木质讲台边缘
data.action: 坐在讲台边纯白连身裙单肩滑落半露香肩小胸，银白长发垂落，单手探入裙摆深层自抚，红瞳泛泪娇喘
data.lighting: 夕阳透过教室玻璃倾泻的浓金逆光与讲台阴影形成的强烈对比
data.camera: cowboy shot, seated podium perspective, focus on blushing face, falling shoulder strap, and crimson eyes
data.promptProse: A stunningly poetic and deeply sensual anime illustration of Kazami Kazuki from The Fruit of Grisaia alone on the wooden teacher's podium of a quiet private studio at golden sunset. Her minimalist white sundress has slipped off one fragile porcelain shoulder, alluringly baring her delicate collarbone and perky modest bust beneath the unbuttoned linen neckline. Floor-length silver hair spills over the edge of the desk as she sits with one slender leg propped up, her manicured fingers gently working beneath her white skirt to soothe her aching, drenched center. Famous for her ruthless intellect, her crimson-red eyes now shimmer with tears of helpless emotional surrender as a heavy blush heats her cheeks. Golden hour dust motes, crisp anime linework, solo 1girl, completely alone in peaceful solitude, fine anime art style.
data.nsfwProse: Sitting upon the private studio podium with her white linen dress slipping off one shoulder, Kazuki pleasures her drenched core beneath her skirt, her crimson eyes glistening with tears as cold intellect dissolves into warm ecstatic longing.
